description: Hand-derived finite outcomes, strict malformed artifacts, scalar embeddings and separate tool-resource boundaries. Source cases are exported afresh by the tested compiler.

cases.name: recursive-product
cases.source:
fn step(n:i64,p:(i64,bool))->(i64,bool) {if n==0 {p} else {step(n-1,(p.0+1,!p.1))}}
fn main()->i64 {let p=step(3,(4,false));if p.1 {p.0} else {0}}
